name: Cool morning harvest
description: Harvest at 06:00 in a cool field (22 C) that warms steadily to 33 C by 14:00. The typical good-practice day in the Dharmapuri belt.
expected_story: Slow early decay: after 8 h a tomato batch has consumed ~11% of shelf life and stays 'fresh'; confidence is 'high' while readings keep coming. Best case for selling far (Hosur/Bengaluru).
